statements: SELECT * FROM mca_stories WHERE chat_id = ? ORDER BY updated_at DESC, story_id LIMIT ?
SELECT old_id FROM mca_story_redirects WHERE old_kind = 'story'

SELECT l.* FROM lore_stories l LEFT JOIN mca_story_legacy_links g ON g.lore_story_id = l.id WHERE l.chat_id = ? AND COALESCE(g.mapping_status, 'unmapped') != 'mapped' AND COALESCE(excluded_from_retrieval, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(status, '') != 'rejected' ORDER BY l.updated_at DESC LIMIT ?
SELECT source_ref_id FROM mca_source_refs WHERE store = 'telegram' AND entity_type = 'user' AND entity_id = ? AND COALESCE(chat_id, -1) = COALESCE(?, -1) LIMIT 1

WITH cand AS (SELECT id, fact, origin, created_at, target_user, weight, status, last_confirmed_at, tg_message_id, message_timestamp, kind, subject_ref_id, attribution_method, assertion_kind, speaker_author_id, provenance_channel, expires_at, CAST(strftime('%Y', COALESCE(NULLIF(message_timestamp,0),NULLIF(created_at,0)),'unixepoch') AS INT) AS yr, CASE WHEN status='confirmed' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > ?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS valid_now FROM graph_facts WHERE chat_id = ? AND (subject_ref_id = ? OR (subject_ref_id IS NULL AND target_user = ?)) AND COALESCE(attribution_method, '') != 'world_knowledge' AND COALESCE(assertion_kind, '') != 'world_knowledge' AND COALESCE(origin, '') != 'bot_self_reply' AND ((status='confirmed' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > ?)) OR status='archived_fact')), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(yr,0) ORDER BY valid_now DESC, weight DESC, COALESCE(NULLIF(message_timestamp,0), created_at) DESC, id DESC) AS rn FROM cand) SELECT * FROM ranked ORDER BY CASE WHEN rn <= ? THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, valid_now DESC, COALESCE(yr,0) DESC, rn LIMIT ?

WITH cand AS (SELECT id, fact, origin, created_at, target_user, weight, status, last_confirmed_at, tg_message_id, message_timestamp, kind, subject_ref_id, attribution_method, assertion_kind, speaker_author_id, provenance_channel, expires_at, CAST(strftime('%Y', COALESCE(NULLIF(message_timestamp,0),NULLIF(created_at,0)),'unixepoch') AS INT) AS yr, CASE WHEN status='confirmed' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > ?) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS valid_now FROM graph_facts WHERE chat_id = ? AND 1=1 AND COALESCE(attribution_method, '') != 'world_knowledge' AND COALESCE(assertion_kind, '') != 'world_knowledge' AND COALESCE(origin, '') != 'bot_self_reply' AND id NOT IN (?,?) AND ((status='confirmed' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > ?)) OR status='archived_fact')), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(yr,0) ORDER BY valid_now DESC, weight DESC, COALESCE(NULLIF(message_timestamp,0), created_at) DESC, id DESC) AS rn FROM cand) SELECT * FROM ranked ORDER BY CASE WHEN rn <= ? THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, valid_now DESC, COALESCE(yr,0) DESC, rn LIMIT ?

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.chat_id, m.text, m.reply_to_id, m.timestamp, m.media_type, m.author_name, m.is_forward, m.forward_source, m.tg_message_id FROM smart_messages_fts JOIN smart_messages m ON m.id = smart_messages_fts.rowid WHERE smart_messages_fts MATCH ? AND m.chat_id = ? ORDER BY smart_messages_fts.rank LIMIT ?

SELECT f.id, f.fact, f.origin, f.created_at, f.target_user, f.weight, f.last_confirmed_at, f.message_timestamp, f.status, f.importance, f.tg_message_id, f.forward_from, f.expires_at, f.subject_ref_id, f.attribution_method, f.assertion_kind, f.speaker_author_id, f.provenance_channel, COALESCE(f.message_timestamp, f.created_at) AS rag_ts FROM graph_facts_fts JOIN graph_facts f ON f.id = graph_facts_fts.rowid WHERE graph_facts_fts MATCH ? AND f.chat_id = ? AND (f.expires_at IS NULL OR f.expires_at > ?) AND f.status IN ('confirmed') AND f.origin != 'bot_direct_reply' AND f.origin != 'bot_self_reply' ORDER BY graph_facts_fts.rank LIMIT ?
